steps.title: Open inlet valve to vacuum
steps.instruction: Open the inlet valve labeled RL to connect the system to the vacuum line.

steps.title: Select reference gas
steps.instruction: Press F1 twice to switch the system to the reference‑gas side.

steps.title: Fill reference loop with gas
steps.instruction: Ensure the second valve (top) is closed, then open the first valve for approximately 5 seconds to fill the collection loop with reference gas.

steps.title: Close reference valve
steps.instruction: Close the valve that supplies reference gas.

steps.title: Transfer reference gas to detector
steps.instruction: Make sure the first valve is closed, then open the second valve to let reference gas flow from the collection loop into the inlet; observe a change in Beam 1 intensity and wait until the signal stabilizes, indicating all gas has left the loop.

steps.title: Repeat reference gas cycle
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 3–5 two additional times (three cycles total).

steps.title: Check Beam 1 baseline
steps.instruction: Observe Beam 1 intensity; it should be ≤ 1 × 10⁻¹², with a typical value around 5 × 10⁻⁹.

steps.title: Set target beam intensity
steps.instruction: Enter a target intensity of 6 × 10⁻⁹ (press V, then B, then Enter) to keep measurements at a consistent concentration.

steps.title: Adjust variable volume
steps.instruction: If Beam 1 intensity deviates from the 6 × 10⁻⁹ target, adjust the variable volume in small increments of ±5 units; re‑check both sample and reference intensities before proceeding.

steps.title: Start run and load paper
steps.instruction: Open the LV valve, ensure fresh paper is loaded in the printer, then start the acquisition run.

steps.title: Select sample side
steps.instruction: Press F1 twice to switch from reference to sample mode.

steps.title: Check sample line cleanliness
steps.instruction: Confirm Beam 1 intensity is ~1 × 10⁻¹², indicating little residual gas in the system.

steps.title: Reset sample volume
steps.instruction: Set the sample variable volume to zero (V A 0).

steps.title: Connect sample tube
steps.instruction: Attach the closed sample tube (valve SI) to the system.

steps.title: Vacuum sample inlet
steps.instruction: Close valve SF, then open valve SI (SP is already open) to evacuate the sample inlet.

steps.title: Check Pirani gauge pressure
steps.instruction: Watch the Pirani gauge; when it reads 1 × 10⁻³, wait an additional 10 seconds to ensure the inlet loop is gas‑free.

steps.title: Isolate inlet from pump
steps.instruction: Close valves SP and SI, then open valve SF.

steps.title: Open collection tube
steps.instruction: Carefully open the collection tube; the transducer value will rise as gas builds behind valve SI.

steps.title: Inject sample gas
steps.instruction: Open valve SI to admit sample gas; wait for Beam 1 intensity to stabilize. If intensity does not rise, the sample may contain only water—close the sample immediately and re‑vacuum.

steps.title: Re‑set reference beam
steps.instruction: Switch to reference side (F1 twice) and set target Beam 1 intensity to 6 × 10⁻⁹ (V B 6e‑9).

steps.title: Enter sample ID
steps.instruction: From the ESC menu, select D, enter the sample ID, and confirm (Cold finger: N).

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Ensure the printer has paper, then note all measured values in the lab notebook.

steps.title: Vacuum and reset after sample
steps.instruction: Open valves SF and SP, then reset the sample variable volume to zero (V A 0).

steps.title: Scroll to results
steps.instruction: Use the cursor to scroll to the bottom of the page to view results; do not change any settings.

steps.title: Isolate reference lines
steps.instruction: Close valve RP and open valve RF to prepare for loading reference gas.

steps.title: Close second valve
steps.instruction: Close the second valve used previously for reference‑gas transfer.

steps.title: Flood system with reference gas
steps.instruction: Close LV, open the vacuum line, then open valves RP, SP, and SF to flood both sides of the device with reference gas.

steps.title: Isolate all valves
steps.instruction: Close valves RF, RI, SF, and SI to isolate the system.

steps.title: Open cleaning valves
steps.instruction: Open all valves on both sides except SI and RI to purge the system; keep the vacuum pump running continuously.
